homeFaq.title: Frequently asked questions
homeFaq.description: Quick answers about free calculators, U.S.-focused defaults, common formulas, and how to use the tools.
homeFaq.a0: Daily Calculations is a free online calculator website for everyday decisions, including finance, health, measurements, taxes, auto, home, time, and education tools.
homeFaq.q1: How do I calculate 15% of a total?
homeFaq.a1: To calculate 15% of a total, multiply the total by 0.15. For example, 15% of $80 is 80 x 0.15 = $12.
homeFaq.q2: How do I calculate a mortgage payment?
homeFaq.a2: Use the mortgage calculator with your loan amount, annual interest rate, loan term, and down payment. It estimates the monthly payment, total cost, total interest, and loan principal.
homeFaq.q3: How do I calculate sales tax on a purchase?
homeFaq.a3: Multiply the purchase amount by the sales tax rate, then add the tax amount to the original price. The sales tax calculator does this instantly for any rate you enter.
homeFaq.q4: How do I calculate a tip and split the bill?
homeFaq.a4: Enter the bill amount, tip percentage, and number of people in the tip calculator. It shows the tip amount, total bill, and each person's share.
homeFaq.q5: How do I calculate BMI using pounds and inches?
homeFaq.a5: BMI is calculated as weight in pounds divided by height in inches squared, then multiplied by 703. The BMI calculator uses this standard U.S. formula.
homeFaq.q6: How do I convert miles to kilometers?
homeFaq.a6: Multiply miles by 1.60934 to convert to kilometers. For example, 10 miles is about 16.09 kilometers.
homeFaq.q7: How do I convert Fahrenheit to Celsius?
homeFaq.a7: Subtract 32 from the Fahrenheit temperature, then multiply by 5/9. For example, 68 F is 20 C.
homeFaq.q8: How do I calculate compound interest?
homeFaq.a8: Compound interest grows from both your starting balance and accumulated interest. Enter your starting balance, annual rate, years, and monthly contribution to estimate future value.
homeFaq.q9: How do I estimate my car payment?
homeFaq.a9: Use the car payment calculator with the car price, down payment, annual interest rate, and loan term. It estimates your monthly payment and total interest.
homeFaq.q10: How do I calculate gas cost for a trip?
homeFaq.a10: Divide trip distance by your vehicle MPG, then multiply by the fuel price per gallon. The gas cost calculator also shows the estimated gallons needed.
homeFaq.a11: Multiply each course grade point by its credit hours, add the results, then divide by total credit hours. The GPA calculator supports common 4.0 scale planning.
homeFaq.q12: Are Daily Calculations calculators free to use?
homeFaq.a12: Yes. Daily Calculations calculators are free to use, require no signup, and show results instantly in your browser.
homeFaq.q13: Are the results financial, tax, or medical advice?
homeFaq.a13: No. Daily Calculations provides estimates based on the numbers you enter. For financial, tax, legal, or medical decisions, review the results with a qualified professional.

homeSeo.title: Free Online Calculator — Instant, Accurate & No Signup Required
homeSeo.p1: Whether you need a mortgage calculator to plan your home purchase, a loan calculator to compare repayment options, or a BMI calculator to track your health goals, Daily Calculations gives you fast, reliable answers — completely free, with no account required. Every calculator on this site is designed to load instantly, work on any device, and return results the moment you enter your numbers.
homeSeo.p2: Managing money starts with understanding the numbers. Our mortgage calculator lets you enter your home price, down payment, interest rate, and loan term to see your exact monthly payment and total interest cost. The auto loan calculator — also called a car loan calculator — does the same for vehicle financing, giving you a clear car payment calculator so you know exactly what you'll owe each month before you sign. For longer-term wealth building, the compound interest calculator shows how your savings or investments grow over time, and the investment calculator models returns across different contribution amounts and time horizons.
homeSeo.p3: Health and fitness tools are just as important. The BMI calculator uses your height and weight to compute your Body Mass Index and helps you understand where you fall on standard health ranges. The calorie calculator estimates your daily caloric needs based on age, weight, height, and activity level, while the TDEE calculator (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) gives you a precise maintenance calorie target to support weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain goals.
homeSeo.p4: Students and professionals rely on Daily Calculations for academic planning too. The GPA calculator helps you compute your current grade point average or project what grades you need to hit your target. The final grade calculator is especially handy at the end of a semester — enter your current grade and the weight of your final exam to see exactly what score you need to pass or earn a specific letter grade.
homeSeo.p5: Everyday math is easier with the right tools. The percentage calculator handles tip splits, discounts, tax rates, and markups. The paycheck calculator breaks down your gross pay, federal and state withholdings, and net take-home amount so you always know what to expect on payday. The age calculator tells you your exact age in years, months, and days — useful for everything from birthday planning to legal and medical forms. The time calculator adds and subtracts hours and minutes for scheduling, billing, and time tracking.
homeSeo.p6: For more advanced needs, Daily Calculations includes a scientific calculator for trigonometric, logarithmic, and exponential functions, and a graphing calculator for visualizing equations and functions. Every tool is built with accessibility in mind — clear labels, high contrast, and keyboard support — so anyone can use them regardless of device or ability.
homeSeo.p7: Daily Calculations' mission is simple: give everyone access to accurate, fast, and free calculators for the decisions that matter most — financial, health, academic, and everyday. Bookmark this page and use it as your go-to calculator hub whenever you need a quick, trustworthy answer.

about.title: About Daily Calculations

about.intro: Daily Calculations is a free collection of online calculators built for everyday decisions — no account required, no ads tracking you, just fast and accurate results.
about.missionBody: We believe useful tools should be accessible to everyone. Our goal is to make the math behind everyday decisions — mortgages, budgets, health metrics, unit conversions — simple and instant.
about.whatWeOfferBody: Over 40 calculators across finance, health, measurements, taxes, auto, and education. Each tool is designed to give you clear, instant results with no signup and no clutter.
about.whyFreeBody: Daily Calculations is supported by minimal, non-intrusive advertising. We will never require an account or sell your personal data to use any calculator on this site.

about.contactBody: Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a new calculator? Head to our Contact page — we read every message.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Read the Daily Calculations privacy policy — what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacyPolicy.section1Body: Daily Calculations does not require you to create an account. We do not collect your name, email address, or any personally identifiable information unless you voluntarily submit it via the suggestion form. Calculator inputs are processed entirely in your browser and are never sent to our servers.
privacyPolicy.section2Body: We use privacy-respecting analytics to understand which calculators are most useful and how visitors navigate the site. This data is aggregated and anonymized — it cannot be used to identify you personally.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: We use a single cookie to remember your preferred color theme (light or dark mode). No tracking cookies or advertising cookies are set by Daily Calculations itself.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: We may use third-party services such as analytics providers. These services have their own privacy policies and may set their own cookies. We choose providers with strong privacy commitments and, where possible, configure them to minimize data collection.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: Since we collect minimal data, there is little to retain. Theme preference is stored in your browser's local storage and can be cleared at any time by clearing your browser data.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of any personal data we hold about you. Because we collect almost no personal data, this right rarely applies — but if you have a concern, please contact us.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository or use the suggestion form on this site.
